gui.echo_warrior.summoner.skill.egyptian: Creepers within a 30-block sphere cannot complete an explosion.
They panic and flee when igniting or taking direct damage.
The Egyptian Archer deals 20% more damage to undead creatures.
Click to cycle: Off → Leaf-shaped Arrow → Cone-point Arrow.
Leaf-shaped arrows bleed and slow targets, leaving a yellow trail.
Click to cycle: Off → Leaf-shaped Arrow → Cone-point Arrow.
Cone-point arrows ignore 35% armor and may pierce, leaving a black trail.
Retreats along a stable safe path only when enemies pose a close threat.
More nearby enemies increase the chance to fire at a second target.
When an enemy comes within 4 blocks, leap 5 blocks along the safest clear route.
Stores 2 charges, restores one every 6 seconds, and volleys up to 6 targets.
Projectile knockback is reduced by 95% in total.
Each effective swing grants 6% attack damage, up to 5 stacks for 8 seconds.
A hit refreshes all stacks; hitting several enemies still grants only one stack.
Missing health grants up to 30% final damage reduction; blade flames intensify with stacks.
Normal attacks become broad frontal sector slashes.
The 3.25-block, 220-degree area deals full damage to every target hit.
Intelligently commits to a full four-hit combo against groups or durable enemies.
The four area strikes deal 70%, 100%, 70%, and 180% damage.
Advances 3 blocks and smoothly traverses one-block height changes.
The first strike launches briefly; the second deflects incoming hostile projectiles.
12-second cooldown; real melee or projectile hits shorten it by 0.5 seconds without a reduction cap.
Zanshin
Dodge rises smoothly as health falls: 20% at full health and 60% at 1 health.
Each successful damage segment grants +20% dodge for 1 second; further hits refresh it, capped at 80% total.
A dodge cancels the entire hit, knockback, and new on-hit effects, then grants 1 Fumikomi charge.
Existing fire, poison, wither, falling, and other ongoing or environmental damage cannot be dodged.
Fumikomi
Restores 1 charge every 5 seconds, up to 3; a successful dodge immediately grants 1.
Dash when a target is outside normal range but within 8 blocks; spend 1 charge only when an attack follows.
The dash is invulnerable, preserves gravity, and traverses one-block height changes, but cannot cross walls or cliffs.
Charges are preserved in melee range, when the dash is blocked, or when the target is lost.
Zan
The first normal slash covers a 90-degree sector: 100% to the primary target and 50% to others.
If a visible enemy remains in the 160-degree follow-up sector, chain into the second slash and snapshot its targets.
The second slash deals 100%/50%; enemies entering after the branch or appearing through walls are excluded.
Stab
Automatically used on a 10-second cooldown when a visible target is within 2.25 blocks.
The thrust hits tightly lined enemies in a narrow 2.75-block capsule for 150% damage.
Targets actually struck are briefly unable to move or attack for the impalement presentation.
The draw-out only affects the original set for 300% damage, light knockback, and blood particles.
Always plays at authored speed regardless of attack speed; misses and early deaths still complete the motion.
